name: search_cisco_se_specs
description: Search the official Cisco and H3C data-center switch specification facts (read-only). Returns the top matching facts with vendor, SKU, attribute, value, unit and the official source title, URL and section.

query.description: The SKU and attribute to look up (e.g. 'N9332D-H2R 400G ports rack units', 'S9827-64EP interface type')
